angleRead.name: Anthony Raines
angleRead.text: I’m focusing on John Ellis’s bounce-back performance in Game 5, which clinched the A’s their seventh World Series title under Mike Paulson. The numbers tell the story: 6 innings pitched, 2 earned runs, and 5 strikeouts. Eric Taveras provided the power with a home run and two RBIs, supported by veterans Darrin Davis and Mark Aitken. This feels like a moment to dig into how Ellis steadied himself after earlier struggles and how Taveras stepped up when it mattered most.
